svg.text: A KV cache of only 3 blocks, four requests: step by step
A, B and C take the 3 blocks. D does not fit, so it waits.
B emits <eos>; its block is freed.
D takes the free block. Prefill and decode never share a step, so A and C sit out.
A has filled its first block and needs a second. None is free, so D, the newest,
is evicted and A takes its block: A now holds 2 blocks, C holds 1.
D waits until a block is free again, when A or C finishes.
